title: Coca-Cola Appoints David Elkins as CFO to Succeed John Murphy
summary: Coca-Cola named Bristol Myers Squibb CFO David Elkins as its next CFO, effective April 2, 2027, succeeding John Murphy, who stays on as president.
body_markdown:
Gotrade News - Coca-Cola ([KO](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/ko/) ) named Bristol Myers Squibb finance chief David Elkins as its next executive vice president and chief financial officer, effective Friday, April 2, 2027, succeeding John Murphy, who will continue as president, according to[Coca-Cola's official release](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/21344/000155278126000567/e26458_ex99-1.htm) on Monday, November 23, 2026.

## Who Coca-Cola Appointed


Elkins, 58, has served as EVP and CFO of Bristol Myers Squibb since 2019, according to the release. He joined that company in 2019 when it acquired Celgene, where he was serving as EVP and CFO. Before that, he was CFO for the consumer products and medical device businesses and corporate functions at Johnson & Johnson, and his earlier roles include positions with Becton, Dickinson and AstraZeneca. He began his career in finance at The Boeing Co.
